units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:11">Ab. IV, 11</cite> <he>העושה … קינה לו פ׳ אחד</he> he that does a good deed, acquires an advocate for himself, opp. <he>קטגיר</he>. Sifra M’tsorʿa, Neg., Par. 3, ch. III <he>חטאת דומה לפ׳ שנכנס לרצות רצה פ׳ וכ׳</he> a sin-offering is like an intercessor that enters (the royal palace) to appease (the king); when the intercessor has succeeded, the present is sent in (the burnt-offering follows); <cite ref="Zevachim 7b:9">Zeb. 7ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Peah 4:21">Tosef. Peah IV, 21</cite> (v. infra); a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="Q02006"><he>פְּרַקְלִיטִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 32a:6">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>כל העולה … פ׳ גדולים וכ׳</he> when one ascends the scaffold to be put to death, if he has prominent intercessors, he is pardoned &c.; <he>ואלו הן פ׳ של אדם וכ׳</he> these are man’s intercessors (before divine judgment): repentance and good deeds.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 10a:11">B. Bath. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>כל צדקה … שלום ופ׳ גדולין בין וכ׳</he> all acts of charity and benevolence … are great peace (makers) and intercessors between Israel and his Father in heaven; (Tosef. l. c. <he>פרקליט גדול ושלום</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:1:2">Y. Taan. I, beg. 63ᶜ</cite> <he>פ׳ לפים</he> intercessors praying for rain; a. e.
